strategic_thesis: Nin should be treated as a watercolor painter whose visual interests overlap with photobook and artist-book culture. Photos are reference evidence, not the career category.
best_opportunity_types: artist grants for works on paper
zine or artist-book translations of watercolor series
bad_opportunity_types: photobook-only competitions unless paintings are translated into a book
large booth events with no curatorial framing

project_directions.title: Quiet Neighborhood Watercolors
project_directions.description: A coherent watercolor series based on ordinary neighborhoods, shopfronts, plants, walls, doors, and lived-in architectural details.

project_directions.title: Human Trace / Works on Paper
project_directions.description: A focused group of watercolors about indirect human presence in domestic and public spaces.

project_directions.title: Small Places
project_directions.description: A low-pressure series of small watercolors for bookstores, cafes, artist-run spaces, or small gallery walls.

project_directions.title: Watercolor Artist Book
project_directions.description: A zine or artist-book translation of watercolor works, using book sequencing while keeping painting primary.
